title: The Arecibo Observatory radio telescope in Puerto Rico has collapsed (Sad Day in Astronomy)
excerpt: One of the largest radio telescope. (1,000-foot-diameter) has collapsed. The hanging structure crashed through Arecibo’s radio dish after major cable failures.…
body:
One of the largest radio telescope. (1,000-foot-diameter) has collapsed. The hanging structure crashed through Arecibo’s radio dish after major cable failures.
